thread:
toni_finance: Noticed vendor export from VecData omitted a tail segment causing under-billing for customer 'AcmeCo'. Portal shows 0.6M tokens used yesterday but ledger shows 0.57M. ~30k tokens missing. @julie_billing @rahul_engineering

rahul_engineering: VecData's CSV splitter truncated at 10MB due to an edge case in their S3 stream. We ingest the CSV as-is, so missing lines never made it into events.

julie_billing: Can you paste the sample lines missing and a quick query to quantify affected customers? Need counts to compute credits.

rahul_engineering: quick query I ran: ```sql
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(v.tokens) as vendor_tokens, SUM(l.tokens) as ledger_tokens, (SUM(v.tokens)-SUM(l.tokens)) as delta
FROM vendor_ingest v
LEFT JOIN ledger_entries l ON l.external_id = v.record_id
WHERE v.vendor='vecdata' AND v.ingest_date='2026-03-22'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING delta>0;
```
Result: AcmeCo delta = 29,412 tokens.

toni_finance: Rough dollar impact = 29,412 * $0.0001 = $2.94. Small but we need tidy books and vendor fix.

sam_ops: Ops can run a targeted re-ingest from VecData raw S3 file; they published a new complete file with suffix '-full'. Propose re-ingest for records older than 1h and create ledger rows with idempotency key vecdata-reingest-20260322.

julie_billing: Approve the re-ingest and credit memo for $2.94. GL code: 6702. No director approval needed.

billing-bot: "Reingest job queued (job id: vec-reingest-2026-03-23-11). Status: queued."

rahul_engineering: I'll also add a validator to reject vendor CSVs that are truncated (line count mismatch + checksum). Filed ENG-5301.

lisa_revenueops: Please include a short note to AcmeCo acknowledging the correction and that the credit will be applied to next invoice. I'll coordinate the customer message.

sam_ops: Reingest completed for AcmeCo; inserted 12 ledger rows, delta reconciled.

toni_finance: Credit memo drafted and queued for next invoice and GL coded. Closing the loop, and monitor VecData ingest for 24h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
